Ivy Chen: Hi all — tiny onboarding calendar snag. I got two Day 1 invites: one says 08:00 local, the other shows as an all-day placeholder. Which one should I keep?
Marco Diaz: Keep the timed one (08:00). The all-day is a legacy placeholder from the admissions export. Decline the placeholder and uncheck 'Send response' so hosts aren't notified.
Ivy Chen: On iOS the title is truncated so I couldn't see the suffix. Any quick way to tell?
Marco Diaz: Open the event details — the correct event ends with '(local)'. We also put a short note in the description: 'Use event with suffix (local)'.
Ivy Chen: Thanks. Two other quick Qs: where will the recording show up, and will captions be attached?
Onboard Bot: @channel Recording flow: Zoom cloud -> queued -> copied to onboarding S3 -> presigned link posted in this thread (~15-60m) -> VTT transcript attached alongside -> archived to Onboarding Drive/Notion within 48h. Presigned links expire in 7 days.
Ivy Chen: Great. My phone's webview blocks redirects and when I tap the mini-preview it falls back to the Zoom cloud page asking for a passcode. Any workaround for mobile-only folks?
Calendar Team: We're rolling a small change: ICS will include a short static redirect URL (e.g., https://onboard.redwood.link/1999) that server-side forwards to the current presigned link. That avoids client-side redirects to S3. Patch scheduled tonight.
Ivy Chen: Nice. Will that redirect be secure?
IT Support: Yes — the redirect checks a rotating token and issues the presigned URL server-side. We won't put raw S3 URLs in the ICS. If you'd like early access, DM us and we can email the Drive/Notion link after archival.
Marco Diaz: One more: if you see duplicated invites because of timezone settings, set your calendar display timezone to your primary zone and accept the '(local)' event only. We're also pushing a cleanup to the exporter.
Onboard Bot: Calendar exporter deploy: v2.20 -> staging 04/02 02:00 UTC, prod 04/02 22:00 UTC. We'll post here when live.
Ivy Chen: Thanks everyone! Appreciate the fast responses. :pray:
